description: Start a purchase of a promotional-credit pack for the connected account. Returns a secure Stripe checkout link that the USER opens to pay — you never handle card details, and payment happens on Stripe's page, not here. After they pay, the credits are added to their account and can be spent with promote_listing. One pack = 5 credits (each promotes one property for ~14 days).

locale.description: Language for the checkout page (default es)

name: buy_promotional_credits
title: Buy Promotional Credits
